detail.title: Method for transporting load with adhesion surface using vacuum lifter
detail.abstract: The vacuum lifter (12) has a first vacuum producer (17), the suction side of which is connectable to the vacuum reservoir (16) and is connected to a main flow feed. It has a second vacuum producer (18), the suction side of which is connectable with the vacuum reservoir (16). A control device for control of the vacuum producers is so provided that the first vacuum producer is switched on at the point of readiness to operate. The second vacuum producer when the first vacuum producer ceases to operate is connectable to a battery. The second vacuum producer is connected to the main flow feed.

In the drawing, the invention is illustrated in more detail by means of a schematically illustrated embodiment. The figure symbolizes a warehouse 1 , in which only the side walls 2 and the bottom 3 are shown. Both extend essentially perpendicular to the plane of the drawing.

A transport device 4 is provided in the upper area of the warehouse. The transport device 4 has in a usual manner a crane bridge 5 , on which a crane trolley 6 can be moved in the directions of the double arrow A. The free ends of the crane bridge 5 are supported on rails 7 , 8 which rest on rail supports 9 , 10 arranged on the inner sides of the side walls 2 . The rails 7 , 8 and the rail supports 9 , 10 extend perpendicular to the plane of the drawing horizontally, so that the crane bridge 5 together with the crane trolley 6 can be moved in this direction.

The crane trolley 6 has a pulley-like lifting device 11 , at the lower end of which a vacuum lifter 12 is suspended. Via a lifting motor 13 on the crane trolley 6 , the vacuum lifter can be moved vertically, as shown in enlarged form.

The vacuum lifter 12 has on its underside an adhesive surface 14 with a plurality of concentrically arranged, circular sealing rings. In the middle of the adhesive surface 14 , a centering pin 15 projects downward. Above the adhesive surface 14 , the vacuum lifter 12 has a vacuum reservoir 16 which is formed as a large cavity. The vacuum reservoir 16 can be opened toward the adhesive surface 14 by means of valves, not shown here.

The vacuum reservoir 16 has a connection to the suction side of a first vacuum generator 17 , which is arranged on the top of the vacuum reservoir 16 . Furthermore, a second vacuum generator 18 is arranged on the top of the vacuum reservoir 16 , the suction side of which is also connectable to the vacuum reservoir 16 . Both vacuum generators 17 , 18 have electric motors as drives, which are connected to the power supply. The second vacuum generator 18 is driven by a DC motor, which is connected to the power supply via a rectifier. The second vacuum generator 18 additionally has its own power supply via a battery.
In the illustration shown, a paper roll 19 , likewise enlarged, adheres to the adhesive surface 14 and is wound onto a winding tube 20 . In this winding tube 20, the centering pin 15 surrounds .

The vacuum lifter 12 has a control device which controls the individual functions of the vacuum lifter 12 and here in particular the vacuum generators 17 , 18 as follows. In operational readiness, the first vacuum generator 17 is switched on, ie connected to the power supply. It runs regardless of whether a paper roll 19 is hanging on the vacuum lifter 12 or not. He keeps the vacuum reservoir constantly under vacuum, so that a maximum vacuum supply is available when taking up a paper roll 19 .

When placing the vacuum lifter 12 on a paper roll 19 , the control device ensures that the second vacuum generator 18 is switched on, ie is connected to the power supply. For this purpose, the control device has a sensor which detects the approach or the placement of the vacuum lifter 12 on or on the paper roller 19 and gives a corresponding signal to the control device. During the transport of the paper roll 19 , both vacuum generators 17 , 18 remain switched on, so that a high vacuum force is generated even with a relatively air-permeable load. Depending on the design of the first vacuum generator 17, this results in a high reserve.

In the event of a power failure, the direct current motor of the second vacuum generator 18 receives direct current from the battery, with the help of a bypass circuit bridging the rectifier. This ensures an uninterrupted operation of the two th vacuum generator, the capacity of which is designed so that a fall of the paper roll 19 is avoided. To ensure a gun Stige energy utilization of the battery, the second vacuum generator is operated intermittently between a obe ren and a lower vacuum pressure level in such a manner that the second vacuum generator off 18 on reaching the upper Vaku umdruckwertes and kuumdruckwert to drop to the lower Va turned on again becomes. In addition, a signal is given and / or the vacuum lifter 12 is stopped with the paper roll 19 at a suitable point.

The control device also has a pressure sensor which detects the vacuum pressure in the vacuum reservoir 16 . If the control device determines that the vacuum pressure drops, an emergency program is also started, which ultimately leads to an emergency lowering of the paper roll 19 .
